verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation describing desktop sync clients, selective sync, or on-demand/online-only files for Box. The only related evidence is community commentary describing the Box desktop client as clunky, CPU-intensive, and lacking a modern 'Default Sync Folder' model, with no mention of selective sync or on-demand files at all. Missing for 10: any documentation of macOS/Windows desktop clients, selective sync feature, on-demand/online-only file support, or independent confirmation these work.
